subject: Finlytics POC — success criteria & kickoff plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@finlytics.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Finlytics POC — success criteria & kickoff plan

Hi Samir / Priya — great conversation earlier. Thanks for taking the time to walk through Finlytics' evaluation goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC timeline: 

TL;DR proposed POC (2 weeks):
- Success criteria: 1) End-to-end inference latency under 300ms p95 for the 2k token workload, 2) embedding similarity accuracy > 0.82 on baseline prompt set, 3) cost per 1k queries below your current baseline by at least 20% (model + infra).
- Deliverables: staffed POC environment in your GCP project, sample traces & latency dashboard, evaluation report with perf/cost/quality.
- Kickoff: week of Aug 17 (we can do Mon/Tue preferred).

Owners:
- Redwood: me (POC lead), Vivek (runtime config, infra), Marcus (support & integration).
- Finlytics: Samir (product lead), Priya (data/platform).

Open items for you to confirm:
1) Approve success criteria above or propose edits (particularly the accuracy threshold).
2) Confirm GCP project id and whether we should use a service account (preferred) or a temporary key.
3) Provide a small sample dataset (anonymized) and 2-3 example prompts we should include in the evaluation suite.

Attachments: Finlytics_POC_success_criteria.xlsx (working success-criteria sheet), Redwood_POCPlan_v1.docx (detailed runbook).

If that looks good I’ll send an updated runbook and calendar invites for a 30-min kickoff.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

---
On Mon, 10 Aug 2026 at 14:05 Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@finlytics.ai> wrote:
> Great meeting — excited to move fast.
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@finlytics.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finlytics.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Finlytics POC — success criteria & kickoff plan

Thanks Marissa — this is super helpful. Quick notes: 
- Success criteria: agreed on latency and cost goals. For embedding similarity, can we set the threshold to 0.80 (vs 0.82) for the first pass and iterate? Our baseline evaluation was done on a noisy copy of our data.
- We’ll own providing the sample dataset and example prompts. Priya will be the POC technical owner on our side.
- GCP project: finlytics-prod-test (we'll create a dedicated project for the POC). We prefer using a service account with limited permissions; I'll have our infra team provision and share the service account email by EOD Friday Aug 13.

Can you also share a short SOC2 compliance summary and the network requirements (eg, IP allowlist) so our security team can sign off?

I’ve attached a short doc from our side listing the example prompts we care about.

Samir
Product Lead, Finlytics
samir.gupta@finlytics.ai

Subject: Updated: Finlytics POC plan & timeline (v2)

Thanks Samir — I made the change to the embedding threshold (0.80) and updated the runbook with the clarified owners and timing. Summary of updates in Redwood_POCPlan_v2.docx (attached):

POC timeline (target):
- Prep (Aug 13-16): service account provisioned, sample data shared, access validated.
- Kickoff + infra deploy (Aug 17): 30-min kickoff, Redwood deploys runtime into your GCP project and runs baseline tests.
- Evaluation (Aug 18-26): perf/quality runs, daily checks and one status call mid-week.
- Wrap & report (Aug 27-28): evaluation report and next-step recommendations.

Task owners (high level):
- Service account + infra access: Priya (Finlytics).
- Sample dataset + labels: Priya / Data team (Finlytics).
- Runtime config & model selection: Vivek (Redwood).
- Integration & test harness: Marcus (Redwood).
- POC success sign-off: Samir (Finlytics) + Marissa (Redwood).

Network & security: attaching SOC2_Summary.pdf and a short allowlist guide. Priya — once you have the service account email, we’ll send a tailored IAM role and the minimal IP range to allow.

Next steps: please confirm kickoff slot: Mon Aug 17 at 10am PT or Tue Aug 18 at 9am PT. Also drop the service account email when ready.

Attachments: Redwood_POCPlan_v2.docx, SOC2_Summary.pdf

Cheers,
Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Hi team — small weekly nudge and status update as we head into the kickoff week. Current status: 
- Service account: pending (Priya — placeholder from infra expected Aug 13).
- Sample dataset: awaiting upload (Priya).
- Kickoff slot: holding Mon Aug 17 10am PT (pending confirmation).

Checklist for the next 72 hours (priority):
1) Priya to confirm service account email & grant minimal roles (storage read, compute deploy).
2) Finlytics to upload anonymized sample dataset to the temporary bucket and share path.
3) Redwood to prepare baseline run (we’ll validate infra and run a quick perf test on first deploy).

If we miss the prep window our evaluation timeline shifts by ~1 week. Can we do a 20-min sync Thu Aug 20 at 11am PT to unblock any outstanding infra questions? I’ll send a calendar invite for the slot; if that doesn’t work propose a time.

Short ask replies are fine — a one-line status update from Priya / Samir will do.

Thanks —
Marissa
